# 玉籙資度解壇儀

**ID:** KR5b0194
**Custom ID:** ZB5b0194

**Editions:** SJB, ZHDZ

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The closing rite (*jiětán yí* 解壇儀, "altar-dismissal liturgy") of the **Yùlù zīdù** 玉籙資度 cycle. Where [KR5b0193](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5b/KR5b0193) inaugurates the fast with the *sùqǐ* vigil, the present text formally dismisses the gods and disassembles the altar at its conclusion. Counterpart in the *Jīnlù* series is [KR5b0175](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5b/KR5b0175).

**Abstract**

The *jiětán* sequence comprises (1) a final *huíxiàng* 迴向 of merit, dedicated to the deceased on whose behalf the *zīdù* was performed; (2) the *xièshén* 謝神 thanksgiving to all summoned deities; (3) the *bàisòng* 拜送 dismissal proper; and (4) the dismantling of the *tánjiè* 壇界 altar boundary. The opening rubric stands directly on f. 1a without a *Lǜ* numbering, indicating that DZ 500 was transmitted as a standalone fascicle within the *Yùlù* series.

Following Schipper & Verellen (*Taoist Canon* 2: 1003–1004, John Lagerwey), the *jiětán* and *shèjiào* texts (DZ 500, DZ 501) frame the daily *cháo* rites and the recitation-cycle ([KR5b0196](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5b/KR5b0196)–[KR5b0200](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5b/KR5b0200)) of the *Yùlù*. Cosmologically, the dismissal is the inverse of the *sùqǐ* and completes the ritual closure of the spatio-temporal field that the fast had opened.
